_comment: Editorial corrections to the Devices and Materials Production syllabus. These are
THIS manuscript's own slips, so they live here rather than in the engine (the
general defects it shared with the rest of the family -- the empty trailing matrix
row and the gap in the S/N column -- are fixed in src/typeset/ instead).
Every change below is a numbering or grammar repair. NONE of them rewrites a
competence, an activity or an expected standard: the syllabus content is the
author's and CDC's.
STILL OUTSTANDING -- needs the author, not the typesetter:
* Row 16 has NO subtopic title: its SUBTOPIC cell is empty in the manuscript. The row
is set as sub-topic 1.4.3 (number only) with its competence 1.4.3.1 ('Use different
Supportive devices...', 2.1.1.3 in the manuscript). The missing title cannot be
recovered from the manuscript -- the author must supply it.
* 1.8.3 'Multi-Sensory Resources' duplicates 1.7.4 'Multi-Sensory Resources'
verbatim -- same competence, activities and standard -- under a different topic.
Possibly deliberate, possibly a paste; left exactly as written.
* Topic 1.6 (Hearing Impairments): its two sub-topics were numbered 1.6.2 and 1.6.3, with
no 1.6.1. Renumbered 1.6.1 / 1.6.2 (competences 1.6.1.1 / 1.6.2.1) on 2026-10-12 -- confirm.
The two still share ONE row (activities and standards run together in the same cells);
splitting them means deciding which bullet belongs to which, so that is left as written.
* 1.9.2 'Introduction to Physiotherapy' (1.10.2 in the manuscript) sits under Assistive
Technology and Digital Accessibility, though the next topic is Physiotherapy. Left as written.
2026-10-11 re-typeset: topics 1.5, 1.6 and 1.7 were three titles in ONE topic cell, so Word's
auto-numbering labelled the Visual Impairments rows 1.7.x. Each title now heads its own rows
and the Visual rows are 1.5.1-1.5.3. With the duplicated 1.9 block gone, 1.10 and 1.11 close
up to 1.9 and 1.10. Missing spaces after numbers restored (1.8.1Communication -> 1.8.1 ...).

removeRow._why: 1.9.1 and 1.9.2 repeat 1.8.1 and 1.8.2 word for word -- same subtopic, competence, activities and expected standard -- under a second copy of the topic title 'Production of Learning Materials for Learners with Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities'. Only 1.9.3 (Assistive Technology Devices) is new, so the duplicated pair is dropped and 1.9.3 renumbered 1.8.4 below. Its TOPIC cell is empty, so it merges up into the 1.8 topic automatically.

pageBreakBefore._why: 2026-10-12: with the matrix's full stops made consistent the matrix runs a little longer, and the assessment section broke with only 'CA + EXAM = 100%' and Time Allocation on a page of their own. The assessment section now opens its own page and stays whole.
